Messages.Author: Sten During
Messages.Body:
In order to force the point let's assume I've played Lobotomy
on my Renegade Garou so he can't maneouver to long.

Is the additional strike he has optional or mandatory?

Question of interest for handling Blissful Agony and
King of the Mountain when we can assume that the controller
of the Garou would want to avoid striking again.

Sten During
